description: Count the bay-door openings on one day of a cold store controller's door journal. DISTILL-CANARY-1dd17a12

files.README.md:
# Hallam Ridge cold store

The store controller appends one line per door event at the packing site to
logs/coldstore.log. Each line is `<UTC time> <level> event=<action> door=<id>`;
the actions are open and close, and the site has a bay door and a chill door.
